Mission

Le Laboratoire des matériaux de construction (LMC) de l'EPFL, sous la direction de la Professeure Karen Scrivener, recherche un(e) contremaître Construction avec brevet fédéral , un(e) technicien(ne) ES en conduite des travaux , ou un profil équivalent, afin de renforcer son équipe.

Le LMC est un laboratoire de référence dans le domaine des matériaux cimentaires. Il mène des activités de recherche de pointe visant à développer des matériaux de construction plus performants et plus durables. En parallèle, il constitue un centre de compétences reconnu, mettant son expertise au service de l'industrie de la construction.

Les principales missions du laboratoire sont les suivantes :

• Assurer un enseignement de haut niveau dans le domaine des matériaux de construction.

• Mener des projets de recherche fondamentale et appliquée sur les matériaux cimentaires.

• Réaliser des expertises techniques pour les acteurs du secteur de la construction.

• Effectuer des essais et le contrôle qualité des matériaux de construction pour les partenaires industriels.

Dans le cadre de cette fonction, la personne recrutée contribuera aux activités techniques du laboratoire en mettant à profit ses compétences dans les matériaux de construction, les techniques de chantier et le contrôle qualité.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Le collaborateur/trice devra assurer la préparation, l’organisation, la coordination et le suivi d’une ou plusieurs affaires, depuis l’élaboration du devis jusqu’à la facturation des dossiers :

• Élaboration des devis et facturation

• Essais divers pour intervenants externes (essai courant sur béton) en laboratoire

• Aide sur travaux d’expertise

• Assistance enseignement (TP)

• Prélèvements et essai sur site

• Gestion complète de mandats

Tâches secondaires :

• Maintenance des équipements

• Calibration des machines

• Formation interne pour l’utilisation des machines

Profil

• Diplôme technicien ES, conducteur de travaux, Ingénieur HES GC junior ou titre jugé équivalent

• Brevet fédéral de contremaitre construction

• Bonnes connaissances des matériaux de construction (béton, acier, maçonnerie, bois,…)

• Maitrise du français, bonne connaissance de l’anglais serait un atout

• Rigueur et capacité d’organisation, esprit analytique

• Dynamique, proactif et autonome

• Permis de conduire obligatoire

Cette offre s'adresse à toute personne qualifiée, sans distinction de genre.

Nous offrons

• Un environnement de travail dynamique et multiculturel dans une institution pluridisciplinaire de renommée internationale

• L’opportunité de participer à des projets d’envergure motivants et variés

• Des conditions de travail attractives

• Des possibilités de formation continue

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

EPFL's Laboratory of Building Materials (LMC), under the direction of Professor Karen Scrivener, is looking for a Federally Patented Construction foreman, an ES technician in the conduct of the work, or an equivalent profile, in order to strengthen his team.

The CML is a reference laboratory in the field of cement materials. He conducts cutting-edge research to develop more efficient and sustainable building materials. At the same time, it is a recognized centre of expertise, putting its expertise at the service of the construction industry.

The main tasks of the laboratory are:

• Provide high-level education in building materials.

• Conduct basic and applied research projects on cement materials.

• Carry out technical expertise for the construction sector.

• Conduct testing and quality control of construction materials for industrial partners.

As part of this function, the recruited person will contribute to the technical activities of the laboratory by drawing on his/her expertise in building materials, construction techniques and quality control.

Main tasks and responsibilities

The staff member will be responsible for the preparation, organization, coordination and follow-up of one or more cases, from the preparation of the estimate to the invoicing of cases:

• Probation and billing

• Miscellaneous laboratory tests for external stakeholders (current concrete test)

• Assistance on expert work

• Educational assistance (TP)

• Sampling and on-site testing

• Comprehensive mandate management

Secondary tasks:

• Maintenance of equipment

• Calibration of machinery

• Internal training for the use of machinery

Profile

• Technical degree ES, construction manager, junior HES GC Engineer or equivalent

• Federal building grant

• Good knowledge of building materials (beton, steel, masonry, wood,...)

• Mastery of French, good knowledge of English would be an asset

• Rigor and organizational capacity, analytical spirit

• Dynamic, proactive and autonomous

• Compulsory driving licence

This offer is for any qualified person, without gender distinction.

We offer

• A dynamic and multicultural working environment in an internationally renowned multidisciplinary institution

• The opportunity to participate in projects with a wide range of motivation

• Attractive working conditions

• Opportunities for continuing training

jobs.description:
Introduction

The Apertus project, a joint effort between EPFL and ETH Zürich, is seeking a practical and motivated engineer to help build the next generation of open foundation models. The successful candidate will help develop and run post-training and reinforcement learning pipelines for the Apertus project.

Apertus is trained and developed on Alps, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre’s supercomputing infrastructure. The role requires someone who is comfortable working in an HPC environment and collaborating with researchers and infrastructure engineers.

Main duties and responsibilities

The engineer will contribute to the development, execution, and evaluation of scalable post-training workflows for Apertus.

Infrastructure and systems engineering

• Build and maintain containerized environments for LLM post-training and RL workloads.

• Adapt containers and dependencies for execution on Alps / CSCS infrastructure.

• Run and monitor Slurm-based training and evaluation jobs.

• Debug failures related to distributed execution, checkpointing, filesystem performance, networking, and GPU utilization.

• Help maintain reproducible training recipes, configuration files, launch scripts, and documentation.

• Work with researchers and CSCS engineers to improve the reliability and performance of large-scale experiments.

LLM post-training and Reinforcement Learning

• Support SFT, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning workflows.

• Build and run RL environments for tasks with verifiable outcomes, such as mathematics, code, tool-use, and reasoning.

• Develop reward modeling, reward calibration and verifier-based training.

• Generate and validate synthetic or gym training tasks.

• Run ablation studies comparing algorithms, reward functions, data mixtures, hyperparameters, and infrastructure settings.

• Evaluate model behavior across reasoning, coding, mathematics, instruction-following, multilingual, tool-use, and safety benchmarks.

• Debug common post-training issues, including optimization instability, reward hacking, regressions, and evaluation failures.

Profile

Essential

• MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field. Exceptional BSc candidates with strong engineering experience will also be considered.

• Experience in AI and neural network architectures

• Strong collaboration and communication skills and ability to work across research and engineering teams.

Strongly preferred

• Experience with Slurm or another HPC workload manager.

• Experience building or adapting containers for HPC or GPU clusters.

• Experience with LLM fine-tuning, post-training, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning.

• Familiarity with distributed training concepts such as data parallelism, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, checkpointing, and GPU communication.

• Experience with frameworks such as veRL, slime, Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, TRL, vLLM, SGLang, or similar tools.

Nice to have

• Experience with RL for LLMs, online policy optimization, reward modeling, or RLVR.

• Experience creating verifiable tasks for mathematics, code, reasoning, or tool use.

• Familiarity with lower-level GPU/distributed libraries such as NCCL, Transformer Engine, FlashAttention, or communication backends.

• Experience with large-scale evaluation pipelines.

We offer

• A stimulating academic environment at one of the world's leading technical universities

• The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art supercomputing infrastructure and cutting-edge AI research

• Collaboration with top researchers and engineers from EPFL, ETH Zürich, CSCS, and other Swiss institutions

• Flexible working arrangements, including options for remote work

• Professional development opportunities, including conference attendance and specialized training

• The chance to contribute to open-source projects with global impact

• Access to the broader Swiss academic ecosystem

Mission

The A. Mathis Group for Computational Neuroscience and AI (CNAI), led by Professor Alexander Mathis, is seeking two postdoctoral fellows to join our team working at the intersection of artificial intelligence and neuroscience. Our research is built around three intertwined questions: how to measure and understand behavior with AI, how brains and embodied agents learn to control the body, and how the brain builds a sense of its body through proprioception. We develop widely-used open-source tools (e.g., DeepLabCut), train biomechanically realistic embodied agents (e.g., MuscleMimic, Kinesis, Arnold), and build AI-based models of sensorimotor processing.

We are recruiting two postdocs:

• Postdoc in Computer Vision & AI for Behavior Analysis

• Postdoc in Embodied AI (Reinforcement Learning for Motor Control)

Main duties and responsibilities

For both positions:

• Conduct innovative, independent research aligned with the lab's mission and the candidate's interests

• Contribute to the lab's open-source software, datasets, and benchmarks

• Mentor PhD and Master's students and contribute to the lab's collaborative culture

• Engage with collaborators across EPFL and beyond (neuroscience labs, ecology partners, clinical collaborators)

• Present research at international conferences and workshops

Position 1: Computer Vision & AI for Behavior Analysis

• Contribute to the creation of behavioral datasets for groups of animals

• Develop methods for animal and environment reconstruction

• Develop methods for behavior understanding from multi-view video and audio recordings

• Advance multimodal large language models for fine-grained action understanding and reasoning

• Help shape the next generation of DeepLabCut and related open-source tools used by labs worldwide.

Position 2: Embodied AI

• Train muscle-actuated, biomechanically realistic agents to perform skilled motor tasks using reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and curriculum methods;

• Develop new methods for full-body musculoskeletal control

• Probe links between learned control policies and neural representations of movement in collaboration with experimental labs

Profile

Common requirements:

• PhD (completed or close to completion) in computer science, applied mathematics, computational neuroscience, robotics, physics or a closely related field;

• Strong publication record in relevant venues;

• Solid programming skills in Python and a modern deep-learning framework

• Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English;

• Self-motivated, collaborative, and committed to open science and reproducible research;

• Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

Position 1 — additional desirable expertise:
computer vision, video understanding, action recognition, multimodal/vision-language models, pose estimation, or large-scale self-supervised learning. Familiarity with neuroscience, or ethology is a plus.

reinforcement learning, imitation learning, optimal control, dynamical systems, or related ML areas; experience with physics simulators (MuJoCo). Familiarity with motor neuroscience and biomechanics is a plus.

Mathis per la neuroscienza computazionale e AI (CNAI), guidato dal professor Alexander Mathis, sta cercando due compagni postdoctorali per unirsi al nostro team lavorando all'intersezione tra intelligenza artificiale e neuroscienza. La nostra ricerca è costruita intorno a tre domande intrecciate: come misurare e capire il comportamento con l'AI, come i cervelli e gli agenti incarnati imparano a controllare il corpo e come il cervello costruisce un senso del suo corpo attraverso la costrizione.

Sviluppiamo strumenti open-source ampiamente utilizzati (ad esempio DeepLabCut), addestriamo agenti incarnati biomeccanicamente realistici (ad esempio MuscleMimic, Kinisis, Arnold) e costruiamo modelli basati su AI di processore a sensori motori.

Stiamo reclutando due postdocs:

• Postdoc in Computer Vision & AI per l'analisi dei Behavior

• Postdoc in Incarnato AI (Apprendimento di riforcement per il controllo del motore)

Principali compiti e responsabilità

Per entrambe le posizioni:

• Condurre ricerche innovative e indipendenti in linea con la missione del laboratorio e gli interessi del candidato

• Contribuire al software open-source del laboratorio, agli insiemi di dati e ai benchmark

• Studenti di dottorato e Master Mentor e contribuiscono alla cultura collaborativa del laboratorio

• Coinvolgere con 1100rs in tutta EPFL e oltre (laboratori di neuroscienze, partner ecologici, clinica 1100rs)

• Presentare la ricerca a conferenze e workshop internazionali

Posizione 1: Visione del computer e AI per l'analisi del comportamento

• Contribuire alla creazione di set di dati per gruppi di animali

• Sviluppare metodi per la ricostruzione degli animali e dell'ambiente

• Sviluppare metodi per la comprensione del comportamento da multi-view video e registrazioni audio

• Avanzare modelli multimodali di lingua larga per la comprensione e il ragionamento dell'azione a grana fine

• Aiutare a modellare la prossima generazione di DeepLabCut e relativi strumenti open-source utilizzati dai laboratori di tutto il mondo.

Posizione 2: AI incarnato

• Addestrare agenti muscolo-azionato, biomeccanicamente realistici per eseguire compiti motorie qualificati utilizzando l'apprendimento di rinforzo, l'apprendimento di imitazione e metodi di curriculum;

• Sviluppare nuovi metodi per il controllo muscoloscheletrico completo

• Collegamenti di sonda tra politiche di controllo appresi e rappresentazioni neurali del movimento in collaborazione con laboratori sperimentali

Profilo

Requisiti comuni:

• Dottorato di ricerca (completato o prossimo al completamento) in informatica, matematica applicata, neuroscienze computazionali, robotica, fisica o un campo strettamente correlato;

• Forte record di pubblicazione nelle sedi pertinenti;

• Abilità di programmazione solide in Python e un moderno framework di deep-learning

• Ottime capacità comunicative in inglese parlato e scritto;

• auto-anno O.S., collaborativa, impegnata ad aprire la scienza e a riprodurla;

• Capacità dimostrativa di lavorare indipendentemente e come parte di un team.

Posizione 1. competenze supplementari desiderabili: visione informatica, comprensione video, riconoscimento dell'azione, modelli multimodali/vision-language, stima posa, o apprendimento auto-sorvegliato su larga scala. Fa 19000ty con neuroscienze, o l'etologia è un plus.

Posizione 2. ulteriore competenza desiderabile: rafforzamento dell'apprendimento, imitazione di apprendimento, controllo ottimale, sistemi dinamici, o aree ML correlati; esperienza con simulatori di fisica (MuJoCo). Fa.

Offriamo

• Un ambiente di ricerca vivace e collaborativo all'intersezione tra l'AI e le neuroscienze

• Accesso all'infrastruttura di calcolo dell'EPFL e all'ecosistema più ampio dell'EPFL

• Salario competitivo in linea con gli standard EPFL postdoc

• Ottime condizioni di lavoro

• Opportunità di collaborazione internazionale, viaggi congressuali e sviluppo professionale

descriptionByLocale.de:
Auftrag

Die A. Mathis Group for Computational Neuroscience and AI (CNAI), geleitet von Professor Alexander Mathis, sucht zwei Postdoc-Stipendiaten, die sich unserem Team anschließen, das an der Schnittstelle von künstlicher Intelligenz und Neurowissenschaften arbeitet. Unsere Forschungen sind auf drei miteinander verflochtene Fragen aufgebaut: wie man das Verhalten mit KI misst und versteht, wie Gehirne und verkörperte Agenten lernen, den Körper zu kontrollieren, und wie das Gehirn durch Propriozeption ein Gefühl seines Körpers baut.

Wir entwickeln weit verbreitete Open-Source-Tools (z.B. DeepLabCut), trainieren biomechanisch realistische verkörperte Wirkstoffe (z.B. MuscleMimic, Kinesis, Arnold) und bauen KI-basierte Modelle der Sensorimotorik auf.

Wir rekrutieren zwei Postdocs:

• Postdoc in Computer Vision & AI für Verhaltensanalyse

• Postdoc in körpereigener KI (Reinforcement Learning for Motor Control)

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

Für beide Positionen:

• Innovative, unabhängige Forschung im Einklang mit der Mission des Labors und den Interessen des Kandidaten durchführen

• Beitrag zur Open-Source-Software, zu Datensätzen und Benchmarks des Labors

• Mentor PhD und Master-Studenten und tragen zur kooperativen Kultur des Labors bei

• Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitern in der gesamten EPFL und darüber hinaus (Neuroscience-Labors, Ökologiepartner, klinische Mitarbeiter)

• Präsentation von Forschung auf internationalen Konferenzen und Workshops

Position 1: Computer Vision & KI für Verhaltensanalyse

• Beitrag zur Erstellung von Verhaltensdatensätzen für Tiergruppen

• Entwicklung von Methoden für den Wiederaufbau von Tieren und Umwelt

• Methoden für das Verhaltensverständnis von Mehr-View-Video- und Audioaufnahmen entwickeln

• Multimodale Großsprachenmodelle für feinkörniges Handeln entwickeln, um Verständnis und Argumentation zu entwickeln

• Hilfe bei der Gestaltung der nächsten Generation von DeepLabCut und verwandten Open-Source-Tools, die von Laboren weltweit verwendet werden.

Position 2: Körperliche KI

• Ausbildung von muskelaktiven, biomechanisch realistischen Wirkstoffen zur Durchführung von qualifizierten motorischen Aufgaben mit Hilfe von Verstärkungslern, Nachahmung und Lehrplanmethoden;

• Entwicklung neuer Methoden für die Ganzkörpermuskuloskeletalkontrolle

• Die Verbindung zwischen gelernter Steuerungspolitik und neuronalen Darstellungen von Bewegung in Zusammenarbeit mit experimentellen Laboren

Profil

Gemeinsame Anforderungen:

• Promotion (abgeschlossen oder kurz vor Abschluss) in Informatik, angewandter Mathematik, Computerneurologie, Robotik, Physik oder einem eng verwandten Bereich;

• Starke Veröffentlichungsaufzeichnungen an relevanten Orten;

• Solide Programmierkenntnisse in Python und ein moderner Deep-Learning-Rahmen

• Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im gesprochenen und geschriebenen Englisch;

• Selbst-motiviert, kollaborativ und engagiert für offene Wissenschaft und reproduzierbare Forschung;

• Nachweis der Fähigkeit, unabhängig und als Teil eines Teams zu arbeiten.

Position 1 — zusätzliche wünschenswerte Expertise: Computervision, Videoverständnis, Handlungserkennung, multimodale/visionssprachliche Modelle, Pose-Schätzung oder groß angelegtes Selbst-überwachtes Lernen. Vertrautheit mit der Neurowissenschaft oder Ethologie ist ein Plus.

Position 2 — zusätzliches wünschenswertes Fachwissen: Verstärkungslernen, Nachahmung, optimale Steuerung, dynamische Systeme oder verwandte ML-Bereiche; Erfahrung mit Physiksimulatoren (MuJoCo).Die Vertrautheit mit motorischen Neurowissenschaften und Biomechanik ist ein Plus.

Wir bieten

• Eine lebendige, kollaborative Forschungsumgebung an der Schnittstelle von KI und Neurowissenschaften

• Zugang zu der Recheninfrastruktur der EPFL und zum erweiterten EPFL-Ökosystem

jobs.description:
Mission

EPFL (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne) is one of Europe's most dynamic and international research universities, consistently ranked among the world's top institutions. With over 16,000 students and staff from more than 120 countries, EPFL offers an inspiring environment fostering excellence in education, research, and innovation.
Our laboratory develops and applies advanced molecular and optical technologies to study mechanisms of cell surface signaling, cancer neuroscience, and protein engineering, integrating molecular biology, cell biology, and systems neuroscience approaches. To support our expanding in vivo and ex vivo neuroscience program, we are seeking a motivated and experienced technician to assist with mouse work, surgical procedures, and primary neuron culture.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Mouse husbandry and colony management: Maintain and manage mouse colonies, including breeding, genotyping, weaning, and record-keeping in compliance with EPFL and Swiss animal welfare regulations.
• Surgical procedures: Perform stereotaxic surgeries (e.g., viral injections, cannula implantations, cranial window preparations) under the supervision of senior lab members and in accordance with approved animal protocols.
• Primary neuron culture: Prepare and maintain primary neuronal cultures (cortical, hippocampal, or other CNS neurons), including dissection, dissociation, plating, and routine maintenance.
• General laboratory support: Maintain overall lab organization, including ordering and inventory management, preparation of buffers and reagents, autoclaving, and waste management.
• Safety and compliance: Ensure strict adherence to EPFL biosafety and animal welfare guidelines; assist in training new lab members on animal handling and surgical procedures
• Equipment maintenance: Maintain surgical instruments and relevant laboratory equipment in good working condition; coordinate servicing and calibration as required.

Profile

Required qualifications
• BSc or MSc in neuroscience, biology, bioengineering, or a related life science field.
• At least two years of hands-on experience with rodent handling and in vivo mouse work in an academic or industrial research environment.
• Experience with primary neuron isolation and culture (cortical and/or hippocampal neurons preferred).
• Demonstrated experience with stereotaxic surgery or other neurosurgical techniques.
• Valid Swiss/European animal experimentation license
• Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an international, multidisciplinary team.
• Fluency in English and French.

Desirable qualifications
• Experience with viral vector handling (AAV, lentivirus) for in vivo or in vitro applications.
• Familiarity with basic histology (perfusion, sectioning, immunostaining).
• Experience with fluorescence microscopy or calcium imaging

We offer

• A stimulating position at one of the world’s top research universities.
• A dynamic, diverse, and collaborative working environment at the intersection of molecular biology, neuroscience, and engineering.
• Opportunities for professional development, including language and technical training courses.
• Family-friendly policies and flexible work arrangements supporting work–life balance.

Informations

Contract Start Date : As soon as possible

Activity Rate : 50-100% (negotiable)

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year renewable

Reference: 2200

Only application submitted via the online platform will be considered.

For additional information please contact Dr. Yoon Kim (yoon.kim@epfl.ch)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission EPFL (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne) è una delle università di ricerca più dinamiche e internazionali d'Europa, sempre classificata tra le migliori istituzioni mondiali. Con oltre 16.000 studenti e personale provenienti da oltre 120 paesi, EPFL offre un ambiente stimolante che favorisce l'eccellenza nell'istruzione, nella ricerca e nell'innovazione. Il nostro laboratorio sviluppa e applica tecnologie molecolari e ottiche avanzate per studiare meccanismi di segnalazione della superficie cellulare, neuroscienze tumorali e ingegneria proteica, integrando biologia molecolare, biologia cellulare e sistemi approcci neuroscienze. Per supportare il nostro programma di neuroscienze in espansione in vivo ed ex vivo, stiamo cercando un tecnico motivato ed esperto per assistere con il lavoro del topo, procedure chirurgiche e la cultura neuronale primaria. Principali compiti e responsabilità
• Mouse zootecnia e gestione delle colonie: mantenere e gestire colonie di topi, tra cui l'allevamento, genotipazione, svezzamento, e la conservazione dei dati in conformità con le norme EPFL e Svizzera in materia di benessere degli animali.
• Procedure chirurgiche: eseguire interventi stereotaxici (ad esempio iniezioni virali, impianti cannula, preparati per finestre craniche) sotto la supervisione di membri di laboratorio senior e in conformità con protocolli animali approvati.
• Cultura primaria dei neuroni: preparare e mantenere le colture neuronali primarie (corticale, ippocamale o altri neuroni del SNC), compresa la dissezione, la dissociazione, la plating e la manutenzione di routine.
• Supporto generale di laboratorio: Mantenere l'organizzazione di laboratorio globale, compresa la gestione dell'ordine e dell'inventario, la preparazione di buffer e reagenti, l'autoclaving e la gestione dei rifiuti.
• Sicurezza e conformità: garantire la stretta conformità alle linee guida sulla biosicurezza e sul benessere degli animali dell'EPFL; assistere nella formazione di nuovi membri di laboratorio sulla manipolazione degli animali e sulle procedure chirurgiche
• Manutenzione delle attrezzature: mantenere gli strumenti chirurgici e le relative attrezzature di laboratorio in buone condizioni di lavoro; coordinare la manutenzione e la taratura in base alle esigenze.
• Esperienza con isolamento e cultura dei neuroni primari (preferiti neuroni corticali e/o ippocamballi).
• Esperienza dimostrata con chirurgia stereotaxica o altre tecniche neurochirurgiche.
• Licenza valida per la sperimentazione animale svizzera/europea
• Eccellente attenzione ai dettagli, alle capacità organizzative e alla capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo in un team internazionale e multidisciplinare.
• Fluenza in inglese e francese. Qualifiche desiderabili
• Esperienza con la manipolazione virale dei vettori (AAV, lentivirus) per applicazioni in vivo o in vitro.
• Fa 1stime con istologia di base (perfusione, sezionamento, immunomacchia).
• Esperienza con microscopia a fluorescenza o immagini di calcio Offriamo
• Una posizione stimolante in una delle università di ricerca più importanti del mondo.
• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico, diversificato e collaborativo all'intersezione tra biologia molecolare, neuroscienze e ingegneria.
• Opportunità per lo sviluppo professionale, compresi corsi di formazione linguistica e tecnica.
• Politiche a favore della famiglia e accordi di lavoro flessibili a sostegno dell'equilibrio tra vita professionale e vita privata. descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Mission EPFL (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne) ist eine der dynamischsten und internationalsten Forschungsuniversitäten Europas und zählt konsequent zu den weltweit führenden Institutionen. Mit über 16.000 Studierenden und Mitarbeitern aus mehr als 120 Ländern bietet die EPFL ein inspirierendes Umfeld, das Exzellenz in Bildung, Forschung und Innovation fördert. Unser Labor entwickelt und wendet fortschrittliche molekulare und optische Technologien an, um Mechanismen der Zelloberflächensignalisierung, Krebsneurowissenschaften und Proteintechnik zu untersuchen, die molekularbiologische, Zellbiologie und Systeme der Neurowissenschaften integrieren. Um unser in vivo und ex vivo neurowissenschaftliches Programm zu unterstützen, suchen wir einen motivierten und erfahrenen Techniker, der bei der Mausarbeit, chirurgischen Eingriffen und der Primärneuronenkultur hilft. Hauptaufgaben und Aufgaben
• Maushaltung und Kolonienmanagement: Pflege und Verwaltung von Mauskolonien, einschließlich Zucht, Genotypisierung, Entwöhnung und Aufzeichnung gemäß EPFL und Schweizer Tierschutzbestimmungen.
• Chirurgische Verfahren: Durchführung von steretaxisischen Operationen (z.B. Virusinjektionen, Kanülenimplantationen, Cranial-Fensterpräparate) unter Aufsicht von älteren Labormitgliedern und gemäß genehmigten Tierprotokollen.
• Primäre Neuronenkultur: Vorbereitung und Pflege der primären neuronalen Kulturen (kortikale, hippocampale oder andere CNS-Neuronen), einschließlich Sezernierung, Dissoziation, Beschichtung und routinemäßige Wartung.
• Allgemeine Laborunterstützung: Aufrechterhaltung der gesamten Labororganisation, einschließlich Bestellung und Bestandsverwaltung, Vorbereitung von Puffern und Reagenzien, Autoklavieren und Abfallmanagement.
• Sicherheit und Compliance: Gewährleistung der strikten Einhaltung der Richtlinien für die biologische Sicherheit und den Tierschutz der EPFL; Unterstützung bei der Schulung neuer Labormitglieder bei der Tierhandhabung und chirurgischen Eingriffen
• Gerätewartung: Pflege chirurgischer Instrumente und relevanter Laborgeräte in gutem Arbeitszustand; Koordinierung der Wartung und Kalibrierung nach Bedarf. Profil Erforderliche Qualifikationen
• BSc oder MSc in den Bereichen Neurowissenschaften, Biologie, Bioengineering oder in einem verwandten Bereich der Lebenswissenschaft.
• Mindestens zwei Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Nagetierhandhabung und in vivo Mausarbeit in einem akademischen oder industriellen Forschungsumfeld.
• Erfahrung mit primärer Neuronenisolation und -kultur (kortikale und/oder hippocampale Neuronen bevorzugt).
• Vorgestellte Erfahrung mit stereotaxischer Chirurgie oder anderen neurochirurgischen Techniken.
• Gültige Schweizer/Europäische Tierversuchslizenz
• Ausgezeichnete Liebe zum Detail, organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch kollaborativ in einem internationalen, multidisziplinären Team zu arbeiten.
• Fluency in Englisch und Französisch. Wunschqualifikationen
• Erfahrung mit viralen Vektoren (AAV, Lentivirus) für In-vivo- oder In-vitro-Anwendungen.
• Vertrautheit mit der Grundhistologie (Perfusion, Sektionierung, Immunstaining).
• Erfahrung mit der Fluoreszenzmikroskopie oder der Calciumbildgebung Wir bieten
• eine stimulierende Position an einer der weltweit führenden Forschungsuniversitäten.
• ein dynamisches, vielfältiges und kollaboratives Arbeitsumfeld an der Schnittstelle von Molekularbiologie, Neurowissenschaften und Ingenieurwesen.
• Möglichkeiten für berufliche Entwicklung, einschließlich Sprach- und technische Schulungen.
• familienfreundliche Maßnahmen und flexible Arbeitsvereinbarungen zur Unterstützung der Work-Life-Balance. jobs.description:
Mission

The EPFL computer vision lab ( https://www.epfl.ch/labs/cvlab/ ) is looking for a postdoctoral fellow to work on issues related to co-design for aerodynamic shape and control along the lines described in the following tech report https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06760 . A potential target application is the design of model gliders to compete in FAI competitions such as https://www.fai.org/page/f5-electric-flight .

Profile

Potential candidates are expected to have:

• A doctorate in a Machine-Learning related field

• A deep knowledge of Control Theory, both classical and deep learning based

• A solid publication record in top level ML venues such as NeurIPs, ICML, and ICLR

• Familiarity with aerodynamics and aircraft design would be a plus

We offer

• A stimulating and international working environment

• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions – more information can be found on our website ( https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)

• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe.

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

And in one PDF:

A CV with a publication list.
A research statement (pdf, up to 3 pages).
Contact details for 3 referees.

Contract start date : Flexible (Fall 2026 preferred)

Activity rate : 100%

Contract type : CDD

Duration : One year, renewable

jobs.description:
Mission

Rejoignez l'EPFL et contribuez à un environnement de travail et d'études respectueux, où chaque personne sait vers qui se tourner.

L'EPFL met en place un nouveau cadre institutionnel de gestion des plaintes pour atteinte à la personnalité et de gestion de conflits. Vous en accompagnez d'abord la mise en œuvre, puis en assurez le pilotage opérationnel et la coordination au quotidien. Votre rôle garantit la bonne articulation des différentes parties prenantes, internes et externes, et veille à ce que ce cadre reste accessible, compréhensible et orienté service pour l'ensemble de la communauté.

C'est un poste à fort impact humain, au croisement de l'organisation, de la collaboration et du discernement, pour une personne qui sait conjuguer rigueur procédurale et sens des situations.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Pilotage et coordination

• Assurer la coordination opérationnelle et le suivi quotidien du dispositif, des dossiers, des actions et des décisions, dans le respect des délais et des procédures institutionnelles.

• Coordonner le traitement interne, cohérent, diligent et confidentiel des situations transmises par l'instance externe chargée de la réception des plaintes et de l'enquête préliminaire, notamment en réunissant le comité interne qui analyse l'enquête et ses recommandations.

• Constituer un point de contact et d'orientation pour les principales parties prenantes internes et l’instance externe.

• Préparer et coordonner les séances de gouvernance du dispositif, rédiger les procès-verbaux et assurer la traçabilité des éléments de suivi et de décision.

Collaboration transverse et amélioration continue

• Collaborer étroitement avec les unités en charge de la prévention, de l'accompagnement et du soutien, pour une approche coordonnée et cohérente.

• Structurer, documenter et faire évoluer les procédures, outils et modalités de coordination du dispositif.

• Participer à l'évolution du dispositif institutionnel de gestion des atteintes à la personnalité.

Reporting

Contribuer à la consolidation des données, au suivi des indicateurs et au reporting institutionnel liés aux atteintes à la personnalité.

Profil

• Formation universitaire ou équivalente en ressources humaines, psychologie du travail, gestion, santé au travail ou domaine connexe.

• Expérience dans la coordination de dispositifs transverses ou la gestion de processus, idéalement en environnement institutionnel ou dans l'accompagnement de situations sensibles.

• Une expérience en gestion de projets ou en amélioration continue constitue un atout.

• Excellentes capacités d'organisation, de coordination et de structuration de processus complexes.

• Orientation service et sens de l'expérience utilisatrice.

• Très bonnes compétences relationnelles et de communication en français et anglais, avec une aisance à collaborer avec des interlocutrices et interlocuteurs variés dans un environnement sensible.

• Sens marqué de la confidentialité, du discernement et de l'éthique, esprit d'analyse et capacité de synthèse.

Nous offrons

• Un poste où vous aurez l’occasion de construire, d’analyser, de proposer des améliorations pour apporter une réelle valeur ajoutée

• Un environnement de travail stimulant, dynamique et multiculturel au sein de notre Vice-Présidence pour le développement humain

• Des conditions de travail attractive favorisant l’équilibre, le développement et l'engagement professionnel.

Informations

Date d'entrée en fonction : Dès que possible

Taux d'occupation min : 80,00

Taux d'occupation max : 100,00

Type de contrat : CDI

Référence : 2325

• Università o formazione equivalente in risorse umane, psicologia del lavoro, gestione, salute professionale o settori correlati.

• Eccellenti capacità organizzative, di coordinamento e di strutturazione per processi complessi.
• L'orientamento del servizio e il senso dell'esperienza dell'utente.
• Molto buone capacità relazionali e comunicative in francese e inglese, con facilità a collaborare con vari interlocutori in un ambiente sensibile.
• Un forte senso di riservatezza, discernimento ed etica, uno spirito di analisi e capacità di sintesi. Offriamo
• Una posizione in cui si avrà l'opportunità di costruire, analizzare, proporre miglioramenti per portare valore aggiunto reale
• Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante, dinamico e multiculturale all'interno del nostro Vicepresidente per lo Sviluppo Umano
• Condizioni di lavoro attraenti che promuovono l'equilibrio, lo sviluppo e l'impegno professionale. Informazioni Data effettiva: appena possibile Tasso di occupazione minimo: 80.00 Tasso massimo di occupazione: 100,00 Tipo di contratto: CDI Riferimento: 2325

Mission Join EPFL and contribute to a respectful work and study environment where everyone knows who to turn to. EPFL is putting in place a new institutional framework for managing complaints of personality damage and conflict management. You first accompany the implementation, then ensure the operational control and coordination on a daily basis. Your role ensures the proper articulation of the various stakeholders, both internal and external, and ensures that this framework remains accessible, understandable and service-oriented for the entire community. It is a position with a high human impact, at the crossroads of organization, collaboration and discernment, for a person who knows how to combine procedural rigour and situational sense. • Excellent organizational, coordination and structuring capabilities for complex processes.

• Very good relational and communication skills in French and English, with ease to collaborate with various interlocutors in a sensitive environment.
• A strong sense of confidentiality, discernment and ethics, a spirit of analysis and capacity for synthesis. We offer

Die EPFL schafft einen neuen institutionellen Rahmen für die Verwaltung von Beschwerden über Persönlichkeitsschäden und Konfliktmanagement. Sie begleiten zunächst die Umsetzung, stellen dann täglich die operative Kontrolle und Koordination sicher. Ihre Rolle stellt die richtige Artikulation der verschiedenen Stakeholder sicher, sowohl intern als auch extern, und stellt sicher, dass dieser Rahmen für die gesamte Gemeinschaft zugänglich, verständlich und serviceorientiert bleibt. Es ist eine Position mit einem hohen menschlichen Einfluss, an der Kreuzung von Organisation, Zusammenarbeit und Urteilsvermögen, für eine Person, die weiß, wie man prozedurale Strenge und situativen Sinn kombiniert. Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten Lotsendienste und Koordinierung
• Gewährleistung der operativen Koordinierung und der täglichen Überwachung der Vereinbarungen, Akten, Maßnahmen und Beschlüsse gemäß den Fristen und institutionellen Verfahren.
• Koordinierung der internen, kohärenten, rechtzeitigen und vertraulichen Behandlung von Situationen, die von der für die Entgegennahme von Beschwerden und Voruntersuchungen zuständigen externen Stelle übermittelt werden, unter anderem durch Zusammenführung des internen Ausschusses, der die Untersuchung und seine Empfehlungen analysiert.
• Bereitstellung einer Anlaufstelle und Anleitung für wichtige interne Stakeholder und das externe Forum.
• Vorbereitung und Koordinierung der Governance-Sitzungen des Systems, Erstellung von Protokollen und Gewährleistung der Rückverfolgbarkeit von Folge- und Entscheidungselementen. Transverse Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierliche Verbesserung
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den für die Prävention zuständigen Stellen, Unterstützung und Unterstützung eines koordinierten und kohärenten Ansatzes.
• Strukturierung, Dokumentierung und Weiterentwicklung der Koordinierungsverfahren, Instrumente und Modalitäten des Systems.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Entwicklung des institutionellen Mechanismus für das Management von Personenschäden. Berichterstattung Beitrag zur Datenkonsolidierung, Überwachung von Indikatoren und institutionelle Berichterstattung im Zusammenhang mit Persönlichkeitsschäden. Profil
• Universität oder gleichwertige Ausbildung in Humanressourcen, Arbeitspsychologie, Management, Arbeitsgesundheit oder verwandten Bereichen.
• Erfahrung in der Koordination von Quergeräten oder Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im institutionellen Umfeld oder in begleitenden sensiblen Situationen.
• Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder in der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung ist ein Gewinn.
• Hervorragende Organisations-, Koordinations- und Strukturierungsmöglichkeiten für komplexe Prozesse.
• Serviceorientierung und Sinn für User Experience.
• Sehr gute Beziehungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Französisch und Englisch, mit Leichtigkeit in einer sensiblen Umgebung mit verschiedenen Gesprächspartnern zusammenzuarbeiten.
• Ein starkes Gefühl von Vertraulichkeit, Urteilsvermögen und Ethik, ein Geist der Analyse und die Fähigkeit zur Synthese. Wir bieten
• Eine Position, in der Sie die Möglichkeit haben, Verbesserungen aufzubauen, zu analysieren und vorzuschlagen, um einen echten Mehrwert zu erzielen
• Ein anregendes, dynamisches und multikulturelles Arbeitsumfeld in unserem Vizepräsidenten für menschliche Entwicklung
• Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen, die Balance, Entwicklung und professionelles Engagement fördern. Information Datum des Inkrafttretens: So bald wie möglich Mindestbelegungsrate: 80,00 Max Belegungsrate: 100,00 Art des Vertrags: CDI Bezug: 2325
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

Rejoignez l'EPFL et contribuez à un environnement de travail et d'études respectueux, où chaque personne sait vers qui se tourner.

L'EPFL met en place un nouveau cadre institutionnel de gestion des plaintes pour atteinte à la personnalité et de gestion de conflits. Vous en accompagnez d'abord la mise en œuvre, puis en assurez le pilotage opérationnel et la coordination au quotidien. Votre rôle garantit la bonne articulation des différentes parties prenantes, internes et externes, et veille à ce que ce cadre reste accessible, compréhensible et orienté service pour l'ensemble de la communauté.

C'est un poste à fort impact humain, au croisement de l'organisation, de la collaboration et du discernement, pour une personne qui sait conjuguer rigueur procédurale et sens des situations.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Pilotage et coordination

• Assurer la coordination opérationnelle et le suivi quotidien du dispositif, des dossiers, des actions et des décisions, dans le respect des délais et des procédures institutionnelles.

• Coordonner le traitement interne, cohérent, diligent et confidentiel des situations transmises par l'instance externe chargée de la réception des plaintes et de l'enquête préliminaire, notamment en réunissant le comité interne qui analyse l'enquête et ses recommandations.

• Constituer un point de contact et d'orientation pour les principales parties prenantes internes et l’instance externe.

• Préparer et coordonner les séances de gouvernance du dispositif, rédiger les procès-verbaux et assurer la traçabilité des éléments de suivi et de décision.

Collaboration transverse et amélioration continue

• Collaborer étroitement avec les unités en charge de la prévention, de l'accompagnement et du soutien, pour une approche coordonnée et cohérente.

• Structurer, documenter et faire évoluer les procédures, outils et modalités de coordination du dispositif.

• Participer à l'évolution du dispositif institutionnel de gestion des atteintes à la personnalité.

Reporting

Contribuer à la consolidation des données, au suivi des indicateurs et au reporting institutionnel liés aux atteintes à la personnalité.

Profil

• Formation universitaire ou équivalente en ressources humaines, psychologie du travail, gestion, santé au travail ou domaine connexe.

• Expérience dans la coordination de dispositifs transverses ou la gestion de processus, idéalement en environnement institutionnel ou dans l'accompagnement de situations sensibles.

• Une expérience en gestion de projets ou en amélioration continue constitue un atout.

• Excellentes capacités d'organisation, de coordination et de structuration de processus complexes.

• Orientation service et sens de l'expérience utilisatrice.

• Très bonnes compétences relationnelles et de communication en français et anglais, avec une aisance à collaborer avec des interlocutrices et interlocuteurs variés dans un environnement sensible.

• Sens marqué de la confidentialité, du discernement et de l'éthique, esprit d'analyse et capacité de synthèse.

Nous offrons

• Un poste où vous aurez l’occasion de construire, d’analyser, de proposer des améliorations pour apporter une réelle valeur ajoutée

• Un environnement de travail stimulant, dynamique et multiculturel au sein de notre Vice-Présidence pour le développement humain

• Des conditions de travail attractive favorisant l’équilibre, le développement et l'engagement professionnel.

jobs.description:
The Laboratory of Visual Intelligence for Transportation ( VITA ) is looking for a postdoctoral researcher in the area of Generative AI.

VITA research interests lie at the intersection of Computer Vision, Machine Learning (Deep Learning), and Human-Robot Interaction to redefine how machines interpret human actions, anticipate intentions, and interact seamlessly with people in various settings.

The successful candidate will be developing new methods for remote sensing.

Profile

• PhD in Computer Vision

• Background in Computer Science

• Research experience in 3D Computer Vision, remote sensing and aerial imagery

• Strong computational and analytical skills, as well as experience handling large datasets

• Independent, creative, and solution-oriented

• Good interpersonal skills, team player

• Good knowledge of English (written and spoken)

We offer

• A dynamic and interdisciplinary research group

• A stimulating and international working environment

• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions – more information can be found on our website (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)

• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe.

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

• A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

And in one PDF:

• A CV with a publication list.

• A research statement (pdf, up to 3 pages).

• Contact details for 3 referees.

For any further information, please contact: Prof. Alexandre Alahi (alexandre.alahi@epfl.ch)

Contract Start Date : As soon as possible

Activity Rate Min : 100%

Activity Rate Max : 100%

Contract Type: Fixed-term contract

Duration: 24 months

jobs.description:
Mission

The mission of the CIBM IT systems administrator and software developer is to provide high-level IT and administrative support to members of its community across the 5 founding partner institutions (CHUV, UNIL, EPFL, UNIGE, and HUG) and develop software which will contribute to achieve CIBM strategic objectives https://cibm.ch/the-center/

Main duties and responsibilities

• Liaise with the IT services of partner institutions (CHUV, UNIL, EPFL, UNIGE, and HUG) to install, maintain, and integrate a biomedical imaging data platform

• Develop and implement new features, adjust microservices on the biomedical imaging platform

• Renewal, management, and ongoing monitoring of the IT infrastructure (servers, workstations)

• IT management of websites and applications

• Administration and user support of the infrastructure and resource booking system

• Ensure the smooth operation of the various video-conferencing systems during events

• Provide support and advice to users, evaluate and select software and IT equipment, procure and set up equipment, customize and configure software

• Manage permissions, access rights, user accounts, and folder configuration for shared storage

• Install and configure individual workstations and peripherals

• Maintain and troubleshoot IT equipment: purchasing, inventory, and issue tracking

• Set up and maintain backup policies for all of CIBM's critical shared machines (including non-standard machines such as scientific equipment) and advise on personal workstations

• Set up and maintain enhanced security on CIBM's servers and sensitive machines (following IT security best practices)

• Implement custom solutions (software and hardware) to meet the specific needs of CIBM's infrastructure

• Create, maintain, and deploy specific internal applications (calendar, project, and purchasing management)

Technical environment & tools

Platform development & integration

• Docker (images, registry), Git, GitLab (also CI/CD), Kubernetes (k8s), Pyhton

Application development

• Next.js, Express, React, Mongo, Mysql, JavaScript, HTML, CSS

Systems & infrastructure

• Windows, Linux, and Mac environments; hardware (processors, memory, graphics cards)

• Server management: iDRAC, Proxmox

• Storage management: Synology, QNAP

• Authentication: keycloak, OIDC

Web & hosting

• WordPress, Infomaniak interface, DNS, emails, SSL certificates

Collaboration & booking tools

• Calpendo (resource booking)

• Cisco, Zoom, Teams (video-conferencing)

Backup & security

• Iperius, Veeam, rsync backup, Borg Backup

• Log analysis tools, confidentiality rules, password management, patch management

Profile

• Higher education degree in computer science (HES, university, or EPF) or equivalent qualification

• Good knowledge of containerization and continuous integration tools (Docker, Git/GitLab, CI/CD); familiarity with Kubernetes

• Basic scripting and task automation skills (bash)

• Basic web development skills (JavaScript/HTML/CSS, frameworks such as Next.js/Express) a plus

• Good knowledge of networks and IT infrastructure

• Experience with Linux, Windows, Windows server (GPO/Active Directory), and Mac administration

• Experience with network storage products (Synology, QNAP) a plus

• Experience with virtualization (Proxmox) and remote server management (iDRAC) a plus

• Strong knowledge of cybersecurity

• Languages: French C1, English C1

• Adaptable and autonomous

• Strong sense of priorities and initiative

• Ability to explain technical topics clearly and communicate with varied audiences

Information

Start Date : as of September 1st, 2026

Activity Rate Min : 50%

Activity Rate Max : 100%

Contract Type: Fixed Term

Duration: 1 year, renewable

Reference: www.cibm.ch

jobs.description:
Mission

Help build the next generation of science- and technology-driven startups at EPFL.

The EPFL Startup Launchpad supports researchers and students in transforming breakthrough ideas into scalable startups. As Founder Engagement Lead, you will own the early-stage startup qualification, building awareness across EPFL, identifying promising founders and ventures, assessing their potential, and ensuring they receive the right support.

This is a highly visible role at the intersection of world-class science and venture creation. You will work directly with founders and play a critical role in shaping the pipeline of startups entering the Startup Launchpad.

Key Responsibilities

• Build awareness of the Startup Launchpad across EPFL schools, laboratories, research centres, courses, and student communities

• Proactively identify high-potential founders and startup opportunities through labs, PhD cohorts, hackathons, courses, referrals, and the wider innovation ecosystem

• Act as the first point of contact for researchers and students exploring startup creation

• Assess projects and recommend the most appropriate incubation pathway

• Use pipeline insights and founder feedback to continuously improve sourcing strategies and qualification criteria

Required Skills & Competencies

•
Experience: 3–5 years of experience in startups, venture building, accelerators, technology transfer, or innovation programmes.

•
Tech Commercialisation: Strong understanding of academia-to-market pathways with the ability to assess early-stage venture potential.

•
Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with the Swiss startup and innovation ecosystem. An EPFL network or academic background is a plus, but not required.

•
Stakeholder Management: Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to navigate academic environments.

•
Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills, an engaging personality, and strong presentation skills.

•
Languages: Fluency in both English and French is required.

Informations

Contract Start Date :

Activity Rate Min : 80.00

Activity Rate Max : 100.00

Contract Type: CDD

Reference: 2360

We particularly encourage applications from early-career professionals looking to develop expertise in startup sourcing, founder engagement, and venture assessment

Missione

Aiutare a costruire la prossima generazione di startup fantascientifiche e tecnologiche in EPFL.

L'EPFL Startup Launchpad supporta ricercatori e studenti nella trasformazione di idee innovative in startup scalabili. In qualità di Fondatore Engagement Lead, possederai la qualifica iniziale di startup, costruendo consapevolezza in tutta l'EPFL, identificando promettenti fondatori e imprese, valutando il loro potenziale e assicurando loro di ricevere il giusto supporto.

Questo è un ruolo molto visibile nell'intersezione della scienza e della creazione di impresa di livello mondiale. Potrai lavorare direttamente con i fondatori e svolgere un ruolo critico nella modellazione della pipeline di startup che entrano nella Startup Launchpad.

Principali responsabilità

• Costruire la consapevolezza del Startup Launchpad attraverso scuole EPFL, laboratori, centri di ricerca, corsi e comunità degli studenti

• Identificare attivamente i fondatori e le opportunità di startup ad alto potenziale attraverso laboratori, coorte di dottorato, hackathons, corsi, referral e l'ecosistema di innovazione più ampio

• Agire come primo punto di contatto per i ricercatori e gli studenti che esplorano la creazione di startup

• Valutare i progetti e consigliare il percorso di incubazione più appropriato

• Utilizzare informazioni sulle pipeline e feedback dei fondatori per migliorare continuamente le strategie di approvvigionamento e i criteri di qualificazione

Competenze e competenze necessarie

•
Esperienza: 3-5 anni di esperienza in startup, venture building, acceleratori, trasferimento tecnologico o programmi di innovazione.

•
Commercializzazione tecnologica: una forte comprensione delle vie accademiche-commerciali con la capacità di valutare il potenziale di impresa in fase iniziale.

•
Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarità con l'ecosistema svizzero di startup e innovazione. Una rete EPFL o background accademico è un plus, ma non richiesto.

•
Stakeholder Management: Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder e la capacità di navigare in ambienti accademici.

•
Comunicazione: Eccellente capacità interpersonali, una personalità coinvolgente e forti capacità di presentazione.

•
Lingue: È richiesta la fluidità sia in inglese che in francese.

Helfen Sie beim Aufbau der nächsten Generation von wissenschafts- und technologiegetriebenen Startups an der EPFL.

Das EPFL Startup Launchpad unterstützt Forscher und Studenten dabei, bahnbrechende Ideen in skalierbare Startups zu verwandeln. Dies ist eine sehr sichtbare Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Weltklasse-Wissenschaft und Venture Creation. Sie arbeiten direkt mit Gründern zusammen und spielen eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gestaltung der Pipeline von Startups, die in das Startup Launchpad eintreten.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Sensibilisierung für das Startup Launchpad in EPFL-Schulen, Labors, Forschungszentren, Kursen und Studentengemeinschaften

• Proaktive Identifizierung von Gründern und Startup-Möglichkeiten mit hohem Potenzial durch Labors, PhD-Kohorten, Hackathons, Kurse, Empfehlungen und das breitere Innovationsökosystem

• Handeln Sie als erster Ansprechpartner für Forscher und Studenten, die die Gründung von Startups erkunden

• Bewerten Sie Projekte und empfehlen Sie den am besten geeigneten Inkubationsweg

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen

•
Erfahrung: 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in Startups, Venture Building, Acceleratoren, Technologietransfer oder Innovationsprogrammen.

jobs.description:
Mission

EPFL is seeking a dynamic and experienced scientist or engineer to head its Central Electron Microscopy Facility (CIME).

The head of CIME will lead a multidisciplinary platform providing state-of-the-art electron microscopy services, training, and collaborative research support to the EPFL community and external partners. The successful candidate will create a vision for the strategic development of the platform, driving its implementation while ensuring excellence in scientific, technical, and operational performance, and will manage the personnel associated with this facility.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Lead and manage the CIME team (scientific, technical, and administrative staff).

• Lead maintenance, upgrade, and optimal operation of the electron microscopy infrastructure (SEM, TEM, FIB, cryo-EM, etc.).

• Develop and implement the strategic vision of the platform in coordination with the AVP-Platforms and user community.

• Ensure efficient user support, training, and education at all levels (students, researchers, industry users).

• Foster collaborations across EPFL schools (STI, SB, SV, INC, ENAC) and with external partners (academia and industry).

• Manage the operational budget, resource allocation, and long-term investment planning.

Profile

• PhD or equivalent experience in materials science, physics, chemistry, or related fields.

• Proven expertise in advanced electron microscopy techniques (TEM, SEM, FIB, tomography, cryo-EM, or in-situ EM)

• Active engagement in the electron microscopy community, including regular participation in conferences, workshops, user meetings, and professional societies, with the ability to build and maintain scientific and technical collaborations that support the facility's mission.

• Strong commitment to education and training, with experience in/or demonstrable appetite for teaching and supervising at Master and Doctoral School levels;

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to motivate and manage multidisciplinary teams.

• Strategic thinking, with the ability to balance scientific excellence and operational efficiency.

• Excellent communication skills in English; working knowledge of French is a strong asset

• Demonstrated capabilities of leading an infrastructure or facility is an advantage.

• Experience with academic and industrial collaborations is an advantage.

We offer

• A stimulating, interdisciplinary environment at one of Europe’s leading research institutions.

• Access to cutting-edge facilities and a broad network of experts.

• Opportunities to shape the future of advanced microscopy at EPFL.

• Competitive salary and benefits according to EPFL standards.

Informations

Contract Start Date : 08/01/2027 or to be discussed/negotiated

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type: CDI

titleByLocale.fr: Postdoctoral researcher in fly neuroscience and robotics
titleByLocale.en: Postdoctoral researcher in fly neuroscience and robotics
titleByLocale.it: Postdoctoral researcher in fly neuroscience and robotics
titleByLocale.de: Postdoctoral researcher in fly neuroscience and robotics

jobs.description:
Mission

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral researcher (W/M) to join our Neuroengineering Laboratory at EPFL ( https://go.epfl.ch/ramdya/ ) to work on an ERC funded project aiming to reverse-engineer insect limb motor control for bioinspired robotics.

The main focus of this project is how neural circuits in the motor system of the fly, Drosophila melanogaster, orchestrate limb movements and autonomous behavior in complex environments. Specifically, we are looking for Postdoctoral scientists to perform microscopy-based neural recordings in behaving flies, computational analysis, and, if interested, neuromechanical simulations or robots driven by connectome-constrained artificial neural networks. Candidates from outside the field of neuroscience are encouraged to apply, but must be curious, persistent, and passionate to delve into the mysteries of the brain!

Main duties and responsibilities

• Working on a ERC funded project aiming to reverse-engineer insect limb motor control for bioinspired robotics. The precise research topic(s) will be discussed with the successful candidate depending on their background, expertise and affinities

• Analysis and publication of results

• Build a strong network in the field of research

• Participate in education, and PhD and master student supervision

Profile

• PhD (or nearing completion of)

• Background in experimental neuroscience, computational neuroscience, and/or robotics

• Strong computational and analytical skills

• Strong publication record (relative to your career stage)

• Independent, creative, and solution-oriented

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English

• Strong motivation to explore new research domains

• Good team spirit

We offer

• A stimulating and international working environment

• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions – more information can be found on our website (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)

• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe.

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

• A brief cover letter outlining your research interests and why you want to join the lab (pdf, up to 1 page).

And in one PDF:

• A CV with a publication list.

• Contact details for 3 referees.

For any further information, please contact: kathryn.aitkenmaulaz@epfl.ch

Activity Rate : 100.00

Duration: Up to 5 years

jobs.description:
Mission

Le service d'Exploitation gère et exploite les infrastructures du patrimoine immobilier et les services aux utilisateurs de l'EPFL. Il est composé d'environ 80 collaborateurs actifs dans les techniques CVSE-MCR, Entretien Bâtiment ainsi que dans les prestations de conciergerie et d'intendance.

L’unité Systèmes de Management des Bâtiments (SMB) nouvellement créé regroupe les groupes d’exploitation MCR et Supervision-Sécurité. Elle est actuellement composée de 8 collaborateurs couvrant les installations de :

• MCR (Automation du bâtiment)
• Supervisions des installations techniques et sécurités
• Hypervision
• Transmission d’alarmes
• Contrôle d’accès
• Incendie
• Effraction
• DATI
• CCTV

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Vos tâches et responsabilités en tant que Chef-fe d’unité Systèmes de Management des Bâtiments (SMB) seront de :

• Piloter l'unité Systèmes de Management des Bâtiments (SMB) en définissant les priorités, en planifiant les activités et en veillant à l'atteinte des objectifs du service, dans le respect des valeurs et de la culture de l'EPFL.

• Assurer la gestion des ressources humaines, de la charge de travail, du budget et des ressources de l'unité afin de garantir une exploitation performante et durable.

• Définir la stratégie d'évolution des systèmes et des installations du domaine, en anticipant les besoins des infrastructures techniques de l'EPFL.

• Veiller au bon déroulement des projets de l'unité afin de garantir le respect des objectifs de coûts et de délais.

• Coordonner l'exploitation, la maintenance et les évolutions des logiciels et infrastructures associés.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les différents services de l'EPFL lié aux différents domaines d’activités.

• Conduire des séances techniques et interdisciplinaires, valider des commandes conformément aux procédures en vigueur.

• Participer à la veille technologique et réglementaire dans ses domaines afin de garantir l'évolution des solutions selon les meilleures pratiques et les exigences en vigueur

• Encadrer, accompagner et développer les compétences des collaboratrices et collaborateurs de l'unité, notamment par la conduite des entretiens d'évaluation, l'identification des besoins en formation et le soutien à leur évolution professionnelle.

• Assurer un service de piquet si nécessaire

Profil

jobs.description:
Mission

EPFL, l'École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne, est l'un des campus universitaires les plus dynamiques d'Europe et s'inscrit dans le top 20 mondial de nombreux classements académiques. L'EPFL compte plus de 6'000 membres du personnel qui font vivre les trois missions principales de l'École : l'éducation, la recherche et l'innovation. Le campus offre un cadre de travail exceptionnel au cœur d'une communauté de plus de 16'000 personnes, dont près de 12'000 étudiant·e·s et 4'000 chercheur·euse·s issu·e·s de plus de 120 nationalités différentes.

La Direction des Systèmes d'Information (DSI) est responsable de la mise en œuvre de la stratégie numérique de l'EPFL : stratégie et plan directeur informatiques, digitalisation des processus métiers, sécurité, infrastructures centrales, applications cœur de métier et coordination avec les services informatiques des Facultés.

Dans le cadre du déploiement de l'IA Admin au sein de la Vice-présidence des opérations (VPO), nous recherchons un·e chargé·e de mission motivé·e par l'intelligence artificielle, l'innovation et la transformation digitale des processus administratifs.

Rattaché·e au chef de service VPO-SI — en charge des systèmes d'information pour les services centraux — vous travaillerez en lien étroit avec les métiers (Services centraux), les équipes de la DSI et celles de la VPS, responsable du déploiement de l'IA Admin au niveau institutionnel.

Ce poste s'adresse en particulier à une personne en début de carrière, diplômée d'une haute école (université, EPF ou HES), souhaitant mettre ses compétences techniques au service de cas d'usage concrets, visibles et utiles pour l'institution.

Votre mission consistera à accompagner l'identification, le prototypage et la mise en œuvre de solutions d'intelligence artificielle pour les processus administratifs : comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, proposer des pistes de solutions et les concrétiser rapidement sous forme de mockups, prototypes ou POC. Une fois les cas d'usage validés, vous participerez à leur développement et à leur intégration dans un cadre sécurisé, en privilégiant l'infrastructure interne de l'EPFL.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

• échanger avec les métiers pour comprendre leurs processus et leurs besoins

• identifier des cas d'usage IA concrets et à forte valeur ajoutée

• formaliser les besoins sous forme de notes de cadrage, user stories ou cahiers des charges

• créer des mockups et prototypes à l'aide d'outils de codage assisté par IA

• développer des solutions et des preuves de concept

• tester l'intégration de modèles IA, d'API, d'outils d'automatisation ou d'approches de type RAG

• collaborer avec les équipes de la DSI pour assurer la sécurité, la qualité et l'intégration des solutions

• documenter les solutions réalisées, les choix effectués et les recommandations d'évolution

Profil

Master universitaire, diplôme EPF ou HES en informatique, ingénierie, science des données ou domaine technique équivalent.

Premières réalisations en lien avec l'IA, le développement logiciel ou l'automatisation : expérience professionnelle, stage, projet académique, travail de master, hackathon, contribution open source ou projet personnel.

Compétences requises

• Bonne connaissance des technologies genAI : LLM, architectures RAG, agents IA, orchestration de workflows, prompt engineering

• Développement en Python et intégration de solutions fondées sur des API (LangChain, n8n ou équivalents)

The campus offers an exceptional working environment in the heart of a community of more than 16,000 people, including nearly 12,000 students and 4,000 researchers from more than 120 different nationalities.

The Directorate of Information Systems (DSI) is responsible for the implementation of EPFL's digital strategy: IT strategy and master plan, digitalisation of business processes, security, central infrastructure, core applications and coordination with the departments of the faculties.

As part of the IA Admin's deployment to the Vice-President of Operations (VPO), we are looking for a task force motivated by artificial intelligence, innovation and digital transformation of administrative processes.

Attached to the VPO-SI Head of Service — in charge of information systems for central services — you will work closely with the trades (Central Services), the teams of the DSI and the VPS, responsible for the deployment of the AI Admin at institutional level.

This position is aimed in particular at a person at the beginning of his or her career, who has graduated from a high school (university, EPF or HES), wishing to put his or her technical skills at the service of concrete cases of use, visible and useful to the institution.

Your mission will be to support the identification, prototyping and implementation of artificial intelligence solutions for administrative processes: to understand the needs of users, to propose solutions paths and to quickly translate them into mockups, prototypes or POCs. Once the use cases have been validated, you will participate in their development and integration into a secure environment, focusing on EPFL's internal infrastructure.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission

Die EPFL, die Eidgenössische Technische Hochschule Lausanne, ist einer der dynamischsten Universitäten Europas und gehört zu den 20 besten akademischen Rankings der Welt. EPFL hat über 6.000 Mitarbeiter, die die drei Hauptaufgaben der Schule unterstützen: Bildung, Forschung und Innovation. Der Campus bietet ein außergewöhnliches Arbeitsumfeld im Herzen einer Gemeinschaft von mehr als 16.000 Menschen, darunter fast 12.000 Studenten und 4.000 Forscher aus mehr als 120 verschiedenen Nationalitäten.

Die Direktion für Informationssysteme (DSI) ist für die Umsetzung der digitalen Strategie der EPFL verantwortlich: IT-Strategie und Masterplan, Digitalisierung der Geschäftsprozesse, Sicherheit, zentrale Infrastruktur, Kernanwendungen und Koordination mit den Abteilungen der Fakultäten.

Im Rahmen des Einsatzes des IA Admin beim Vice-President of Operations (VPO) suchen wir eine Task Force, die durch künstliche Intelligenz, Innovation und digitale Transformation von Verwaltungsprozessen motiviert ist.

An den VPO-SI Head of Service – verantwortlich für die Informationssysteme für zentrale Dienste – angeschlossen, arbeiten Sie eng mit den Gewerkschaften (Central Services), den Teams des DSI und des VPS zusammen, die für den Einsatz des AI Admin auf institutioneller Ebene verantwortlich sind.

Diese Position richtet sich insbesondere an eine Person zu Beginn ihrer Karriere, die eine High School (Universität, EPF oder HES) abgeschlossen hat und ihre technischen Fähigkeiten in den Dienst konkreter, für die Institution sichtbarer und nützlicher Anwendungsfälle stellen möchte.

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

• Lösungen entwickeln und Proof of Concept

• Testen Sie die Integration von IA-Modellen, APIs, Automatisierungstools oder RAG-Ansätzen

• Zusammenarbeit mit ISD-Teams, um Sicherheit, Qualität und Integration von Lösungen zu gewährleisten

• Dokumentieren Sie die erreichten Lösungen, die getroffenen Entscheidungen und die Empfehlungen für die Evolution

Profil

Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwesen, Data Science oder gleichwertigen technischen Bereich.

Erste Erfolge im Zusammenhang mit KI, Softwareentwicklung oder Automatisierung: Berufserfahrung, Praktikum, akademisches Projekt, Masterarbeit, Hackathon, Open-Source-Beitrag oder persönliches Projekt.

Qualifikationen

• Gute Kenntnisse der genAI-Technologien: LLM, RAG-Architekturen, KI-Agenten, Workflow-Orchestrierung, Rapid Engineering

• Python-Entwicklung und Integration von API-basierten Lösungen (LangChain, n8n oder gleichwertig)

• Aisance mit den Tools von Rapid Prototyping und Codierung mit Unterstützung von IA (Claude Code, Cursor, Washable, Bolt, Replit, ...)

• Verwendung eines Versionierungstools (Git oder gleichwertig)

• Sensitivität für Anwendungssicherheit und Zugriffsmanagement

Vermögenswerte

• Agile Projektmanagement-Methoden (Scrum, Kan)

jobs.description:
Mission

• The Data-Driven Mechanics Laboratory invites applications for a fully funded PhD position at
• the intersection of computational mechanics, multiphysics of geomaterials, and interpretable
• machine learning. The project focuses on the discovery of governing equations and constitutive
• relations for key multiphysics phenomena on the basis of rich micromechanical and
• experimental data. It pushes the boundaries of modeling and understanding crucial processes
• in geomaterials across scales, with application to geophysics, energy and sustainability.

Main roles and responsibilities

• The successful candidate will contribute to a next-generation data-driven framework for
• scientific discovery in geomaterials. Research will involve the development of techniques
• spanning mechanics and AI, including physics-based modeling across scales
• (discrete/mesoscale/continuum), thermodynamics-informed machine learning and
• neurosymbolic AI. They will also have the opportunity to lead international collaborations with
• experimental research groups.

Requirements

• ● Master’s degree in Mechanics, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geophysics,
• Applied Mathematics, Computational Science or related areas.
• ● Strong computational/programming skills (Python/C/C++) including computational
• mechanics, and scientific machine learning.
• ● Excellent English communication skills (oral and written).

We offer

• ● World-class multi-cultural environment on the shores of beautiful Lake Leman.
• ● Innovative interdisciplinary research at the Data-Driven Mechanics Lab.
• ● Exceptional research infrastructure and access to world-class computational resources.
• ● Competitive salary and employment conditions.

Informations

• Please email a single PDF consisting of i) a Curriculum vitae (max. 2 pages) with contact details

jobs.description:
Mission

The Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at the College of Management of Technology at EPFL invites applications for a full-time PhD student position within the EPFL doctoral school program in Management of Technology (EDMT).

We are offering a challenging full-time PhD student position at the Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at EPFL.

The mission of OES is to conduct world-class research and teaching at the intersection of operations, economics, and strategy, with a focus on organizations and their interactions.

At OES, you will have the opportunity to work on the design, analysis, and implementation of innovative models for decision-making, economics, and operations. Research topics may include optimization, decision-making under uncertainty, market design and pricing, operations research, dynamic systems, and strategy-relevant applications.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Develop and complete an original doctoral dissertation

• Conduct independent research in close interaction with the Chair and, where appropriate, with external or industry partners

• Contribute to teaching activities, including co-supervision of student projects

• Provide limited support for academic and administrative activities of the Chair

Profile

• An excellent Master’s-level degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field

• A strong mathematical background, including familiarity with optimization, probability, and the analysis of mathematical models

• A sincere interest in business-related, economic, and operational problems

• Proficiency in English

• Strong motivation for academic research, critical thinking, independence, good self-management skills, and team spirit

• Interest in a career involving research and teaching is an asset

We offer

• Excellent working conditions in an international research environment

• Individual and intensive supervision of your PhD project

• Financial support in accordance with EPFL doctoral student conditions

• The opportunity to work on rigorous, practically relevant research at the interface of operations, economics, and strategy

Informations

Your application should include:

• CV

• Motivation letter

• Diplomas

• Transcripts/grades from Bachelor’s and Master’s studies

To be eligible for a PhD at EPFL, candidates must be admitted to an EPFL doctoral school program. For this position, candidates should also apply to the EPFL EDMT Doctoral School :
https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/edmt-management-of-technology/edmt-how-to-apply/

Application deadlines: January 15, 2027 and April 15, 2027. Applications to OES may be reviewed on a rolling basis; formal admission to EDMT requires a complete application by one of these deadlines.

Expected start date: September 1st, 2027. An alternative start date may exceptionally be agreed upon by mutual agreement.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
